events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
line='chrX\\t154398500\\tC\\t38\\t..........,....TTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTT"'^~T''^~T''^~T''^~T'"\\tJFFDFDFFFEEJJ@CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC@CCCCC@@\\n'
parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
ref=parts[2]
depth=int(parts[3])
bases=parts[4]
# parse
i=0
counts={'A':0,'C':0,'G':0,'T':0,'.':0,',':0}
while i<len(bases):
    ch=bases[i]
    if ch=='"'^'"':
        i+=2; continue
    if ch in '"'$*+-'"':
        # not present; simplistic
        i+=1; continue
    counts[ch]=counts.get(ch,0)+1
    i+=1
print(ref, depth, counts, sum(counts.values()))
print('ref bases', counts['.']+counts[','])
print('T bases', counts['T'])
print('len bases string', len(bases))
print('quality len', len(parts[5]))
PY"
